message: Stormy weather can sometimes keep us cooped up at home, but I’ve found it’s a perfect excuse to rediscover some low-tech fun! While I don’t miss the days of scrambling for candles, I do enjoy a good game of cards or a cozy read by flashlight. That said, it’s always smart to be prepared—there are some handy tips out there for staying safe, should the weather turn a bit wild. What’s your favorite indoor activity when the storm clouds roll in? ☔
